doc: The device's location under the permission pattern (LCP-036). Availability, permission and outcome are kept apart: an API that is missing, blocked by policy or needs a secure context is Unavailable, never Denied; the user's choice is the permission state; a denial, an unavailable position and a timeout are distinct outcomes. Permission changes, including revocation, arrive as facts. Nothing is requested at initialization: only locate can cause the browser to ask. A granted permission is evidence, never application authorization.

variants.name: permission
variants.doc: The current permission state, without asking.

variants.name: locate
variants.doc: May show the browser's permission prompt when the state is prompt.

variants.name: Permission
variants.doc: state is absent when this browser cannot report it.

variants.name: CannotWatch
variants.doc: This browser cannot report permission changes.

variants.name: Denied
variants.doc: The user or the browser refused this origin the location.

variants.name: PositionUnavailable
variants.doc: Allowed, but the device could not determine a position.

variants.name: PermissionChanged
variants.doc: A revocation is previous granted, state prompt or denied.
